cues.text: Good evening, and welcome to Closing Bell on the Nivesh Desk, your wrap of the day's markets.

cues.text: Here are tonight's headlines.

cues.text: The Nifty ends flat, but smallcaps jump 2.2 percent.

cues.text: Results-day rallies in OneSource, Acutaas Chemicals, Sona BLW and Tata Consumer.

cues.text: First, the scoreboard. The Nifty 50 settled at 22,749.75, down 3.45 points, or 0.02 percent.

cues.text: OneSource surged 13.8 percent on 36 times its usual volume, after profit grew 444 percent from a year ago.
